input.title: Session state is empty after browser refresh
input.body: I store the logged-in user in st.session_state. After pressing F5 the value is gone. Streamlit 1.31.1, Chrome.

input.title: App stuck on loading on my server but works locally
input.body: Opens fine on my machine, but on the server the page stays on the loading screen. Reinstalling did not help.

input.title: st.data_editor crashes when used with a custom component
input.body: The app crashes with a JavaScript error when st.data_editor and a custom component are on the same page. Streamlit 1.35.0, Firefox.
